findings.title: Black lower strip in several scrolled seed captures
findings.detail: Pixels show a solid black lower area below navy application content. It does not cover the visible row controls or transport. This review cannot establish whether it comes from application painting or capture/resize behavior. It prevents a blanket claim that every viewport background is cleanly painted.

findings.title: Medium reopen footer extends below viewport
findings.detail: Last footer line is vertically cut at the image bottom. Core rows and transport remain visible; no horizontal truncation is observed.

findings.severity: qualification limit, not an overlay finding
findings.title: Some initial compact/short captures do not show transport until scrolling
findings.detail: Rows and transport no longer cover one another, but not all content fits simultaneously. Other reviewed scroll checkpoints show the third Card and complete transport. These initial positions alone do not prove reachability.

findings.title: Zoomed third-row reachability not captured
findings.detail: Full scale envelope and transport are readable, but only a sliver of the third row is shown at the table/transport boundary. There is no zoomed scroll-to-third checkpoint. Do not claim complete all-row access or absence of overlap at that boundary from this image alone.

conclusion.waveform: Ten images show the complete eight-region envelope, including quiet ends and six varying interior plateaus. It remains visible after reorder, refusal, export, resize, zoom and reopen. Numeric amplitudes and exact PCM bits remain separate reference evidence.
conclusion.compact_short_reachability: The reviewed before/after scroll positions visibly expose Card 3 selection and full transport below its row in compact and short seed captures and in short reopen. No row/transport overlay is observed at those revealed positions.
conclusion.horizontal_clipping: No horizontal clipping of the reviewed core labels, Card selectors, Clear controls or transport controls observed at captured widths. Medium controls are tightly packed; full responsive or arbitrary-size acceptance is not claimed.
conclusion.copy: Selected timing heading and Bars or Seconds footer are visible; old Bars-only wording is absent in these captures.
remaining_limits: Black lower viewport strips in four seed images.
Screenshots show control visibility and selected state; scenario actions/hit testing and sealed/PCM/WAV equality require separate parent evidence.
No physical audio or microphone qualification.
